component.name: LetraItem
component.script: sub init() m.fundo = m.top.findNode("fundo") m.letra = m.top.findNode("letra") end sub sub onConteudo() m.letra.text = m.top.itemContent.title end sub sub onFoco() f = m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 and m.top.gridHasFocus m.fundo.visible = f if f then m.letra.color = "#0b0e14" else m.letra.color = "#FFFFFF" end sub
